## Status Quo

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggcalendar)

{tribble(~event,     ~date,
        "ggcube",    "2026-08-19",
        "ggdibbler", "2026-09-02") |> 
  ggcalendar() + 
  aes(date = date) +
  geom_calendar_complete() +
  geom_calendar_tile(alpha = .3) + 
  aes(fill = event) +
  geom_calendar_today() +
  geom_calendar_strikeoff()} |>
codehover::ch_hover()

```
